_comment: Cue list for Squatch Life. Two kinds live here. A cue with `prompt` is a sound effect and goes to ElevenLabs sound-generation. A cue with `say` is a line of dialogue and goes to text-to-speech using the voice named in `voice`, resolved against the `voices` block below. Run `npm run sfx` for everything, `npm run sfx:vo` for just the spoken lines. Any cue without a file falls back to the built-in WebAudio synth, so the game is playable either way.

voices._comment: Every spoken line resolves its voice here, so the character sounds like one person. Paste an ElevenLabs voice id into `id` -- `npm run sfx:voices` lists what is on your account. Nothing spoken will generate until this is set.

player._note: The man who lives here. Mid thirties, flat delivery, talks to himself because there is nobody else in. Not doing a bit -- he is just narrating his own afternoon to an empty room.

sfx.say: She likes commitment.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.start.rightBalk-2.1
sfx.say: Again.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.start.rightCatch-1.1
sfx.say: There she is.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.start.brake-1.1
sfx.say: Parking brake off. Gently. They’re more of a written suggestion.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.taxi.begin-1.1
sfx.say: Taxi out. Little bursts of power, then let her roll.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.taxi.begin-2.1
sfx.say: She doesn’t steer like a truck. She steers like an argument.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.taxi.fast-1.1
sfx.say: Slow down. We’re not late for anything that matters.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.taxi.hold-1.1
sfx.say: Hold here. Feet on the brakes, run them both up.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.runup.sputter-1.1
sfx.say: Did that fix it?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.runup.sputter-2.1
sfx.say: It changed the situation.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.runup.done-1.1
sfx.say: Good enough. Line up.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.brief-1.1
sfx.say: Full power. Keep it straight. At sixty, pull back gently.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.takeoff.brief-2.1
sfx.say: What happens at sixty?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.brief-3.1
sfx.say: We find out if I remembered the number.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.rotate-1.1
sfx.say: That’s sixty. Ease her off.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.trees-1.1
sfx.say: Trees. Trees are the last part of the runway nobody paves.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.clear-1.1
sfx.say: Congratulations. You have now flown exactly far enough to be blamed.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.grass-1.1
sfx.say: That’s the grass. The grass is not the runway.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.grass-2.1
sfx.say: Bring her back round and do it with more conviction.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cruise.what-1.1
sfx.say: What exactly are we picking up?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cruise.what-2.1
sfx.say: Beef jerky.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cruise.what-3.1
sfx.say: That’s it?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cruise.what-4.1
sfx.say: Rare beef jerky.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cruise.what-5.1
sfx.say: How rare?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cruise.what-6.1
sfx.say: Possession is a customs event.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cruise.photo-1.1
sfx.say: This is mountain-cured, pepper-crusted Silverback Reserve. Every strip has a serial number.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cruise.photo-2.1
sfx.say: Why is it illegal?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cruise.photo-3.1
sfx.say: Trade agreement. Agricultural rules. Three senators own competing smokehouses. Pick a villain.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.nav.tower-1.1
sfx.say: Broken tower on the nose. Keep it off your left wing and hold what you’ve got.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.nav.river-1.1
sfx.say: River bent like a horseshoe. Follow the open end.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.nav.volcano-1.1
sfx.say: Volcano. Don’t fly through the smoke, it’s rude.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.nav.cliff-1.1
sfx.say: Red cliff. After that it’s all jungle and bad ideas.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.turb.start-1.1
sfx.say: Air’s getting lumpy. That’s the mountains breathing.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.turb.sick-1.1
sfx.say: I need you to fly smoother.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.turb.sick-2.1
sfx.say: I don’t know how.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.turb.sick-3.1
sfx.say: Then learn before my shirt becomes evidence.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.turb.bag-1.1
sfx.say: There are receipts in the sick bag. I’m putting it back.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.falls-1.1
sfx.say: See that waterfall?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.approach.falls-2.1
sfx.say: Yes.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.falls-3.1
sfx.say: Fly toward it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.approach.falls-4.1
sfx.say: There’s a mountain behind it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.falls-5.1
sfx.say: The runway is before the mountain.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.approach.falls-6.1
sfx.say: That feels important.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.valley-1.1
sfx.say: Down into the valley. Power back, flaps out, and pick your line early.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.valley-2.1
sfx.say: You get one. There is no going round again in here.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.high-1.1
sfx.say: Too high.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.high2-1.1
sfx.say: Still too high.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.high3-1.1
sfx.say: Now you’re proving a point.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.low-1.1
sfx.say: Low. Add power before the trees do it for you.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.slow-1.1
sfx.say: Power. Power. POWER.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.fast-1.1
sfx.say: We’re landing here, not in the next country.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.flare-1.1
sfx.say: Hold it off. Hold it. Let her sit down.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.good-1.1
sfx.say: That was a landing. I want that noted somewhere.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.rough-1.1
sfx.say: We arrived before the important pieces fell off. Count it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.bad-1.1
sfx.say: Some of that was flying.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.bad-2.1
sfx.say: Shut it down before anything else agrees to come off.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.cecilio.meet-1.1
sfx.say: Grass-fed. Cold-smoked. Forty-two days in mountain air.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cecilio.meet-2.1
sfx.say: It looks like jerky.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cecilio.silence-1.1
sfx.say: He’s new.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.cecilio.silence-2.1
sfx.say: This is not gas-station meat.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cecilio.silence-3.1
sfx.say: Understood.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.cecilio.silence-4.1
sfx.say: This jerky has lineage.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.brief-1.1
sfx.say: Three crates. Three positions. One in each and she flies like an aeroplane.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.brief-2.1
sfx.say: All three in the back and she flies like a seesaw.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.tail-1.1
sfx.say: Move one forward unless you want the plane climbing before the runway starts.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.nose-1.1
sfx.say: We’re hauling jerky, not trying to drill for oil with the nose.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.strap-1.1
sfx.say: Strap them. Loose cargo is just weight that gets a vote.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.done-1.1
sfx.say: Door shut and latched. Say it out loud so I hear you say it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.lookout.depart.engine-1.1
sfx.say: (radio, urgent) Motor. Two valleys over, coming this way.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.depart.engine-2.1
sfx.say: Aeroplane. Bureau. Go now.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.lou-1.1
sfx.say: You’re flying back.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.depart.lou-2.1
sfx.say: I barely landed.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.lou-3.1
sfx.say: And now you’re experienced.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.seat-1.1
sfx.say: Wake me if an engine quits.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.depart.seat-2.1
sfx.say: Which engine?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.seat-3.1
sfx.say: The loud one.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.downhill-1.1
sfx.say: Downhill. The arrow on the barrel is not decoration.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.downhill-2.1
sfx.say: Keep it rolling.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.depart.runway-1.1
sfx.say: We’re running out of runway.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.runway-2.1
sfx.say: Then stop looking at it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.clear-1.1
sfx.say: Cliff. That’s the good kind of nothing underneath you.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.river-1.1
sfx.say: Stay near the river.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.return.river-2.1
sfx.say: Why?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.river-3.1
sfx.say: Because rivers rarely build towers.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.ridge-1.1
sfx.say: Ridge ahead. Left side.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.return.ridge-2.1
sfx.say: The left side has trees.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.ridge-3.1
sfx.say: The right side has government.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.rain-1.1
sfx.say: Rain. Good. Nobody looks up in it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.caib.caib.sweep-1.1
sfx.say: ...sector four, negative contact, continuing the pattern.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.sweep-2.1
sfx.say: They’re sweeping. Get lower.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.caib.caib.hail-1.1
sfx.say: Unidentified cargo aircraft, alter course and prepare for agricultural inspection.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.hail-2.1
sfx.say: Do not answer.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.caib.hail-3.1
sfx.say: They know we’re here.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.hail-4.1
sfx.say: Knowing and proving are cousins, not twins.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.chase-1.1
sfx.say: Behind us. Don’t climb — climbing is how you introduce yourself.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.chase-2.1
sfx.say: Canyon, cloud, or the saddle in that ridge. Pick one and commit.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.lost-1.1
sfx.say: Gone. Or bored. Both spend the same.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.boundary-1.1
sfx.say: That range behind us is the whole argument. We’re somebody else’s paperwork now.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.hot-1.1
sfx.say: Left one’s running hot. Ease back the left throttle.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.engine.hot-2.1
sfx.say: We need both engines.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.hot-3.1
sfx.say: That is why the plane came with two.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.cooling-1.1
sfx.say: Let it sulk. Fly the other one.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.recovered-1.1
sfx.say: Temperature’s down. Give it half and don’t apologise to it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.sight-1.1
sfx.say: That’s the field. Same as you left it, which is the best it does.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.home.sight-2.1
sfx.say: The runway lights are out.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.sight-3.1
sfx.say: They have been out since the county discovered invoices.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.home.sight-4.1
sfx.say: How do I see the runway?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.headlights-1.1
sfx.say: Community support.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.final-1.1
sfx.say: Crosswind from the left. Point the nose into it and land on the wheel that’s low.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.end.bucket-1.1
sfx.say: So that was the job?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.bucket-2.1
sfx.say: That was the interview.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.bite-1.1
sfx.say: Worth it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.end.envelope-1.1
sfx.say: This is my cut?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.envelope-2.1
sfx.say: You’re still a prospect.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-stall-1.1
sfx.say: Nose down! The sky is not holding meetings today!

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-stall-2.1
sfx.say: Nose down. Down. The other down.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-stall-3.1
sfx.say: You’re out of speed and ideas. Fix the speed one.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-overspeed-1.1
sfx.say: Ease off. She starts shedding parts as a hint.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-overspeed-2.1
sfx.say: That noise is the airframe filing a complaint.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-terrain-1.1
sfx.say: Ground. Ground is a solid.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-terrain-2.1
sfx.say: Up. Now would be the time.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-gearHard-1.1
sfx.say: Feel that? That was the landing gear’s entire remaining career.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-banked-1.1
sfx.say: Level it. My coffee has opinions.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-banked-2.1
sfx.say: That’s a lot of angle for a man with my stomach.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-smooth-1.1
sfx.say: That’s better. Keep doing whatever that was.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-smooth-2.1
sfx.say: Good. Boring. Boring is the whole job.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cargoShift-1.1
sfx.say: Something moved back there. That is never good news.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-patrolClose-1.1
sfx.say: Lower. Trees are free cover and nobody bills you for them.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.called.line.1tsw0zt
sfx.say: (He looks at you for a moment longer than is comfortable.) I did.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.candy.line.d2l6uh
sfx.say: Take one. Everybody takes one. Nobody eats one.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.changed.line.tulsor
sfx.say: Nothing changed. That’s what worries me. It should have, by now.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.confident.line.iqzopd
sfx.say: Everybody knows what they’re doing. The ones who don’t come back knew as well.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.contact.line.vhp8a2
sfx.say: Two of them. One talks, one doesn’t. The one who doesn’t is the one to watch, which I should not have to explain to a grown man.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.doorOpen.line.19tnvci
sfx.say: Close the door. We’re not selling raffle tickets.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.enter.line.1oqaami
sfx.say: (He keeps writing for a moment.) Shut the door.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.envelope.tony.1uitjw6
sfx.say: And then?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.envelope.tony.yscmc9
sfx.say: Fine.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.greet.line.lc299m
sfx.say: You took your time. Relatively speaking.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.greet.line.lki7aa
sfx.say: You’ve been at my bar. I can hear it from here.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.greet.tony.140czgz
sfx.say: I came straight in.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.greet.tony.1dsb0i0
sfx.say: You called. I’m here.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.greet.tony.1g0x304
sfx.say: Your slot machine attacked me.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.greet.tony.1skj0qt
sfx.say: Place looks busy.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.hang.tony.hq4amq
sfx.say: I’m going, Lou.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.hang.tony.s33n16
sfx.say: Clean. Mostly.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.inspecting.line.pj0l8m
sfx.say: It’s a gun, Prospect. Not an engagement ring.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.jerky.line.2tdayz
sfx.say: (He leans forward.) That’s exactly the sentence people say before things get complicated.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.liquor.line.oiyhn4
sfx.say: You complete the errand first. Then you rob my bar.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.machine.line.xqo0ng
sfx.say: That machine has taken more off this crew than the state has. (He breathes out through his nose.) Sit down.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.monitor.line.1eyrta1
sfx.say: Four cameras and none of them point at anything I care about.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.photos.line.pfpdv4
sfx.say: You here to pick up a package or review my decorating?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.questions.tony.13zl6yb
sfx.say: Why give me this here?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.questions.tony.16a5c15
sfx.say: I’ve got it.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.questions.tony.1lahoj6
sfx.say: Who am I meeting?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.questions.tony.wmukgv
sfx.say: Somebody’s watching the club.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.refuse.line.3o4jmh
sfx.say: Then you go anyway and I worry the whole evening. Take it, Prospect.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.sat.line.1js4sny
sfx.say: Good. Sitting. That’s progress.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.straight.line.cjsc8t
sfx.say: You did. I noticed. Don’t get used to being noticed.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.waiting.tony.1ddcl3z
sfx.say: And if I don’t take it?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.waiting.tony.1lavgm7
sfx.say: What is it?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.waiting.tony.43hnhy
sfx.say: (Say nothing.)

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.warning.tony.1rs0tw
sfx.say: What changed?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.warning.tony.awltb1
sfx.say: I know what I’m doing.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.warning.tony.hdjyui
sfx.say: They’re jerky dealers.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.warning.tony.mg3d9s
sfx.say: I understand.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.watched.line.1y0pc91
sfx.say: (He turns the monitor round without hurrying.) …Grey sedan. By the office wall. Alright. Find out whether it follows you. Don’t do anything about it. Find out.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.lou.why.line.5g6i9h
sfx.say: Because here it’s mine, and out there it’s evidence. And because I wanted to look at you before you went.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.dinner.tony.14cm7ow
sfx.say: That was the whole thing. That was all of it.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.dinner.tony.8taeo9
sfx.say: Take my number. Ring it when you are not working.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.fold.line.1ouh5ff
sfx.say: Hm. (She goes back to the glass, but she is smiling at it.) Shame. That was nearly something.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.open.tony.1rf0l6z
sfx.say: (Walk past.)

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.open.tony.1xxg4iv
sfx.say: I was going to walk past.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.open.tony.rnhobt
sfx.say: What are you drinking?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.why.tony.10rytv8
sfx.say: I could have a word about the two hundred.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.why.tony.152qfmo
sfx.say: Good luck with the two hundred.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.why.tony.ijm69l
sfx.say: Let me buy you dinner.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.word.line.15bh53k
sfx.say: (Sharply, and this is the most serious she gets all night.) No. Absolutely not. I have watched what a word costs and I would rather have the two hundred outstanding forever. (A beat, softer.) But thank you for offering it like it was nothing.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.word.tony.1opjzzm
sfx.say: (Leave her to it.)

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.margo.word.tony.9r65as
sfx.say: Then let me buy you dinner instead.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.security.chair.line.1461trs
sfx.say: Check it from a chair.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.security.open.line.1rxz5cn
sfx.say: Prospect. Floor’s down there.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.security.open.tony.18uzeor
sfx.say: Alright, alright.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.security.open.tony.56elm3
sfx.say: I’m checking the structural integrity.
